acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I navigate to the Data Entry page When I click "Add Debt Account" Then I see a form with fields: Account name (required), Account type (dropdown), Current balance (ZAR, min R0), Annual interest rate (0-100%), Minimum monthly payment (ZAR), Lender name (optional)
Given I fill out the form with valid data When I click "Save Account" Then the account is saved to Dexie database with createdAt and updatedAt timestamps
Given a successful save When the operation completes Then I see a success toast "Account saved"
Given I have existing accounts When I view the accounts list Then I see a card for each account showing: name, type icon, current balance (ZAR formatted), interest rate, minimum payment
Given I click "Edit" on an account When the edit form opens Then the form is populated with existing data
Given I modify fields in edit mode and click "Save" When the save completes Then the account is updated in database and I see success toast "Account updated"
Given I click "Delete" on an account When I see the confirmation dialog and confirm Then the account is removed from database
Given a successful delete When the operation completes Then I see success toast "Account deleted"

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use Dexie.js wrapper over IndexedDB. Structured queries with indexes, async operations, React hooks integration via useLiveQuery.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use big.js for all monetary calculations to ensure cent-level accuracy. All monetary values stored as strings.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use shadcn/ui components with React Hook Form + Zod for accessible, type-safe form validation with minimal re-renders.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use Result type for functions that can fail. React components show toast on error. Pattern: { success: true; data: T } | { success: false; error: E }

doc.title: Epic 2 Tech Spec

doc.snippet: UseAccountsReturn interface defines: accounts, isLoading, addAccount, updateAccount, deleteAccount, totalDebt, totalMinPayments.
